_about: Public-domain Horatio Southgate (1812-1894), Episcopal missionary bishop in Constantinople and later rector in Boston and New York, for the Word Hoard: Encouragement to Missionary Effort among Mohamedans, Narrative of a Tour through Armenia, Kurdistan, Persia and Mesopotamia, A Letter to a Friend, the Fredericton consecration sermon, The War in the East, a Holy Guild sermon, Narrative of a Visit to the Syrian (Jacobite) Church, Sermons for the Festivals and Fasts, and The Death of Lincoln. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 104 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

southgate-mohamedans: Encouragement to missionary effort among Mohamedans : a sermon by the Rev. Horatio Southgate, Jun., missionary of the Protestant Episcopal Church in the United States of America, to Persia, etc. ; to which are annexed an account of the meeting held at the Church of the Ascension (New York : Protestant Episcopal Press, 1836)
southgate-tour-armenia-2: Narrative of a Tour Through Armenia, Kurdistan, Persia and Mesopotamia: With an Introduction, vol. 1 (D. Appleton & co., 1840)
southgate-letter-friend: A letter to a friend : in reply to a recent pamphlet, from the missionaries of the American Board of Commissioners for Foreign Missions at Constantinople (New York : D. Appleton ; Philadelphia : G.S. Appleton, 1845)
southgate-fredericton: Sermon preached at the consecration of Christ Church Cathedral, Fredericton, N.B., August 31, 1853 ; by The Right Rev. Horatio Southgate, D.D (Boston : Ticknor, Reed, and Fields, 1853)
southgate-war-in-east: The war in the East (New-York, Pudney & Russell, 1854)
southgate-holy-guild: The sermon preached on occasion of the second anniversary of the Holy Guild of the Church of the Advent : Boston, Mass. on the evening of the First Sunday in Advent, 1854 (Boston : J. Howe, 1855)
southgate-syrian-church: Narrative of a visit to the Syrian (Jacobite) Church of Mesopotamia : with statements and reflections upon the present state of Christianity in Turkey and the character and prospects of the Eastern Churches (New-York : Dana and Co., 1856)
southgate-festivals-fasts: Sermons for some of the principal festivals and fasts of the church and on Christian doctrine and duty : preached at the Church of the Advent, Boston, Massachusetts (New York : D. Dana, 1859)
southgate-death-lincoln: The death of Lincoln (New York, J.W. Amerman, printer, 1865)
